headline: Earnings week tests the AI trade; Brewers clinch World Series berth
top_call: UBS and Baird stay bullish on Semtech. Buy the AI data-center connectivity dip.
backdrop: S&P futures +0.2% into Friday after a bruising AI week (Nasdaq ~−2% week-to-date). 10-year yield near 5.07%; CME FedWatch ~87% odds of an October hold after Fed Chair Warsh offered no hike signal. Hot PPI (+6.3% YoY) and CPI (3.7%) still linger.
